items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: I played with the Kid Oliver Band... Muddy Johnson was playing trombone.

ctx.x: That time. And I played with the Magnolia Band. I played with the Kid Oliver Band, which is set up with different men in there. And I played with Manuel Perez when he had the superior band. Those old fellas, you might know some of them. That's for myself. And Manuel Perez. And, uh, let's see, trombone. Muddy Johnson was playing trombone. Well, Alfred Pico was playing clarinet. Oh, yes.
